questions.questionText: Demand and supply data: A market has price $21 and quantity 1005 units. A policy or market change alters these values. (a) Calculate the percentage change in the relevant variable if the new value is 10% higher. (b) Explain what the change could imply using an appropriate economic concept. (c) Give one limitation of making a conclusion from the data alone.
questions.explanation: A percentage change is calculated relative to the original value. Interpretation should use the relevant economic concept, while recognising that a single dataset may not establish causation or capture all contextual factors.
